correctness.rationale: Proved by explicit radius inflation above one (which preserves exclusion of zero) and coordinate lifting for the upper bound. A ball touching one embedded coordinate sphere must have all other center-coordinate norms at most its radius, while its touching coordinate norm exceeds the radius, so it cannot touch a second axis. Disjoint counts give exact lower bound and optimizer localization. Operator-space isometry follows on canonical basis; independent simplex and orthogonality argument proves real Hilbert component number n+1. The exact rational grid program verifies 3602 sampled inequalities only and is not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Quantifies a currently studied finite-cardinality invariant for every finite real max-sum and classifies the axis structure of every optimal cover. Derives exact kappa(L(ell_1^m,Y))=m*kappa(Y), including sharp Euclidean kappa=m(n+1), a strict m-1 excess over the general mn+1 lower bound for m>1; this is a motivated boundary of the 2026 strictly convex-domain theorem. Does not claim further applications, large novelty, or independent validation.
